"**Man accused of shooting Deputy Sheila Jones in downtown Houston courthouse shootout is identified** ” Houston Chronicle's **John Wayne Ferguson** \-- "The man accused of [shooting a Harris County deputy constable in downtown Houston](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.xjnMFfva-73dHOne5Rc0eNCDHcRdv524vOoQmRT6HI43Rg55yAp-yJ6gTrq7xIMLbKdZwMEZi396jewVC_ieRFUsYRwtaU3o5LyS4WAGc1bfK5ai1O5iULok8Y0qX7EFd9zDheXhLZVMFBumv6If6c1c9vFRZKbImUFIibF-2Wbh3ciPAnsb99faDEJFd8QxY56z7P4fO4ceOy6UKz5GmGnnCBIYe-ttNF_nuU5aKhOqsawpGkjQodw9Jugvk6JFpB8VUY_HAEGW0J-Fh5a6bFSF9ia5Z7evR_KET00V_JI6_t93VkqITYJW9uxxqNh9o1qfDAVEy2jXqnkORT0bcZu971ldJ3Is0BYG5qyvuXRCXhpWDDXql1qk7Amt0jRg-nVAPLt8FLcJkcvKdAgV2z1Hov6C1sTJmozbXbOZZ7EkNYZS5KDZpBe9p3d-QtLM03Wy9KOuIkETTBgnkCSOlC980dhPNAyP9t6bMg5kTnRqFsdi3M0ap9tnwHIZXtJYUoir8RQC28zQRcYimuphBsTwPbknm-aNjbwh07Xwpv4/4fv/tMtnFvvqRKOcOsR6f-p1Pg/h11/h001.-Vg8F5Tnt0_2jba_cxZaJahg5tEF_XC4HAN-mf3sWkw) Monday afternoon was identified Tuesday morning in charging documents accusing him of aggravated assault of a public servant and unlawful carrying of a weapon.

**Parnell Bland** , 34, of Houston, is accused of shooting Precinct 1 deputy constable **Sheila Jones** , according to court records. Jones survived the shooting after a bullet was stopped by her ballistic vest, officials said Monday.

Five deputies approached Bland Monday afternoon after receiving a call about a weapons disturbance near the Harris County Family Law Center. Bland, who authorities said was carrying two handguns, allegedly fled from the deputies before turning and firing a shot at Jones. The deputies returned fire, striking Bland multiple times.

Bullets from the shootout also shattered a window at the county's jury assembly building and broke a pane in a county office building. Only Bland and Jones were hit. Both were expected to survive, officials said.

Bland could ultimately face more assault charges for firing on the each of the deputies who responded to the call, as well as other possible gun charges, Harris County District Attorney **Sean Teare** said Monday.

Bland's criminal history in Harris County includes six felony convictions, three of which were for possession of cocaine. His most recent conviction was for theft in 2018. Bland pleaded guilty and was sentenced to 18 months in state jail. Felons aren't allowed to own or carry weapons in public in Texas.

Bland also has a record of misdemeanor and felony arrests in Liberty County dating back to 2016, including convictions for drug possession, DWI and trespassing. His most recent arrest in Liberty County was in October, when he was sentenced to 45 days in jail on a trespassing charge, according to court records.

On April 15, Bland was also charged with misdemeanor criminal trespass. He was scheduled to appear in Harris County Criminal Court at Law No. 3 on Tuesday morning on that charge.

Officials on Monday didn't speculate why Bland brought the guns downtown or where he might have been going before police were called. Precinct 1 Constable **Allen Rosen** said Bland may have mental health issues, but didn't elaborate.

Court records show that in 2018, Bland was ordered to receive mental health treatment and be restored to competency before facing his felony theft charge. He was deemed fit to stand trial after around 7 months of treatment.

Bland was being treated for his wounds as of Monday, and on Tuesday was not yet listed as being in custody at the Harris County Jail. He was scheduled to make a preliminary appearance in front of a Harris County district judge on Wednesday. Prosecutors have already asked for a hearing to be scheduled so they may argue for Bland's bail to be denied." Jones survived the shooting after a bullet was stopped by her ballistic vest, officials said Monday. Five deputies approached Bland Monday afternoon after receiving a call about a weapons disturbance near the Harris County Family Law Center. Bland, who authorities said was carrying two handguns, allegedly fled from the deputies before turning and firing a shot at Jones. The deputies returned fire, striking Bland multiple times. » Bullets from the shootout also shattered a window at the county's jury assembly building and broke a pane in a county office building. Only Bland and Jones were hit. Both were expected to survive, officials said. Bland could ultimately face more assault charges for firing on the each of the deputies who responded to the call, as well as other possible gun charges, Harris County District Attorney Sean Teare said Monday. » Bland's criminal history in Harris County includes six felony convictions, three of which were for possession of cocaine. His most recent conviction was for theft in 2018. Bland pleaded guilty and was sentenced to 18 months in state jail. Felons aren't allowed to own or carry weapons in public in Texas. Bland also has a record of misdemeanor and felony arrests in Liberty County dating back to 2016, including convictions for drug possession, DWI and trespassing. His most recent arrest in Liberty County was in October, when he was sentenced to 45 days in jail on a trespassing charge, according to court records. On April 15, Bland was also charged with misdemeanor criminal trespass. He was scheduled to appear in Harris County Criminal Court at Law No. 3 on Tuesday morning on that charge. Officials on Monday didn't speculate why Bland brought the guns downtown or where he might have been going before police were called. Precinct 1 Constable Allen Rosen said Bland may have mental health issues, but didn't elaborate. Court records show that in 2018, Bland was ordered to receive mental health treatment and be restored to competency before facing his felony theft charge. He was deemed fit to stand trial after around 7 months of treatment. Bland was being treated for his wounds as of Monday, and on Tuesday was not yet listed as being in custody at the Harris County Jail. He was scheduled to make a preliminary appearance in front of a Harris County district judge on Wednesday. Prosecutors have already asked for a hearing to be scheduled so they may argue for Bland's bail to be denied." When Trump disobeys a court order I’ve won against him, I drag him back in court and force the ruling to take effect. I travel across Arizona and even to other states, to find ways to fight back.

You may not have heard the term Structural Eugenics before, but sadly we live at a time where it's critical we know what it means, and what it looks like. Because MAGA and Trump are showing us what Structural Eugenics looks like--and it is horrifying.
MAGA Republicans are tracking autism, menstrual cycles, criticism of Trump, criticism of Israel, Trans people, and anyone who even dares whisper DEI--but NOT vaccination rates, measles spread, COVID deaths, firearm proliferation, firearm deaths, bird flu cases, people killed by law enforcement, climate change, or food regulations.
This is an unholy recipe for fascism and national disaster. This ~~will kill~~ is already killing people--and I fear that's the MAGA goal. **Let 's Address This.**
**I am doing everything in my power to raise awareness on human rights and justice. I cannot do it alone. I hope you consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.**
[ Upgrade to paid](https://substack..0S1Z6gylWwdr7oXkJbuOd6uorBDELRsMnrd-W8NSqKw?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=161904558)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/84dbc2f7-dc17-4715-8ea8-3f57e95b917c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
A propaganda poster whitewashing Eugenics as beneficial to human evolution.
Eugenics is the discredited and racist theory that selective breeding can and should be used to improve the human race. While many see this as a fascist act of the past, as [Osagie K. Obasogie](https://substack.com/redirect/5f1f0ef9-e101-47c4-be71-1053b226007d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a professor of law and bioethics at UC Berkeley, points out, it has persisted in insidious ways into modern times. Today, in the United States, a troubling trend has emerged where MAGA Republicans prioritize monitoring certain social issues while neglecting critical public health concerns. This selective focus raises alarms about which lives matter. Shocking no one, the group that incessantly changes "all lives matter," doesn't actually believe that either. By enacting eugenicist views as a matter of public policy, MAGAs advance Structural Eugenics. Below I share examples of how the Trump regime is enacting structural eugenics in broad daylight.
## How MAGAs Are Enacting Structural Eugenics
MAGA-aligned officials have concentrated efforts on:
* **Autism Surveillance** : President Trump and Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. [have falsely linked vaccines to autism](https://substack.com/redirect/c4aed655-16a6-4aac-bd01-a3b93f92eee6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), despite scientific consensus debunking this claim. In recent years, this false claim has led to vaccine aversion, leading to increased death and suffering.
* **Menstrual Cycle Tracking** : Some states have proposed or enacted policies allowing the monitoring of women's reproductive health data, raising privacy concerns. In Virginia, the Republican Governor Glenn Youngkin blocked a bill that would have [banned law enforcement from seeking a woman's menstrual history](https://substack.com/redirect/cbbd161f-aaab-4c8e-b702-7ead381f30fa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* **Banning Criticism of Political Figures** : The Trump regime is disappearing and deporting Palestinian students, or any Black or brown person in general, [who is critical of US foreign policy on Israel](https://substack.com/redirect/bdf346bb-2219-4152-9eca-bef86617580b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Furthermore, Trump is set to deport U.S. citizens he doesn't like, [all while wholly denying due process of law](https://substack.com/redirect/2326d67e-8a9e-42d5-af42-ce8f89be429a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). This is de facto authoritarian and fascist.

Dear Reader,

Have you heard of the American Public Health Association?

They're a powerful group of left-wing medical elites who want to _**force DEI on America**_ ... _**Take away your gun rights**_ ... And have _**NO limits on abortions**_.

They work hand-in-glove with the _**corrupt FDA**_.

And now they're _**demanding**_ RFK Jr resign from President Trump's cabinet...

Why? Because RFK Jr is dangerously close to revealing **[the FDA's biggest secret](https://substack.com/redirect/ab9c9616-9a3e-4759-b2fa-93cdf4342e76?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**...

A revelation that could wipe out hundreds-of-billions in Big Pharma profit and dark money political donations. And they may just succeed...

Which is exactly why we're not taking any chances, we're revealing everything TODAY in **[this short video](https://substack.com/redirect/ab9c9616-9a3e-4759-b2fa-93cdf4342e76?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**.

clean_body: | | | Hi Peter, I, just like you, have been feeling the worry, dread, and heaviness of the actions of the Trump administration. There have been countless unprecedented attacks on much more than just our climate and environment, and I know we are all needing hope right now. During times like these, I’m glad that I can look to our member base for a reminder of this community we’ve created. In that, there’s hope. We’re stronger together. These times are requiring us to stand together stronger for our climate and each other, and we will do just that. Our environment continues to unite us, so let’s stay united in this fight. That’s what I’ve always told my boys, Theo and Henry, when we go into nature.

Unsurprisingly, it’s also a reminder that a lot of elected Republicans could use. Ted Cruz said that “climate change is not science.” John Thune said that Democrats are pursuing “a radical environmental agenda.” Donald Trump said that efforts to mitigate the climate crisis are “very expensive global warming bullshit.”

I could go on and on and on.

**I won’t stay silent as the GOP attempts to deny the basic existence of the climate crisis and diminish its urgency.**

That’s why I helped pass the most monumental climate bill in American history and continue to advocate for clean energy, green jobs and holding polluters accountable.

It’s Earth Day, normally a time to celebrate our environment and all we’ve done to preserve and protect it for future generations. _But this year is different._
**Donald Trump and his administration are taking a chainsaw to the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), federal research funding, and regulations that keep our environment clean and safe.**
In just the first 100 days of his second term, Trump has:
* Once again pulled us out of the Paris Climate Agreement;
* Rolled back critical environmental protections and set energy regulations to expire in 5 years;
* Issued an order to block states from enforcing their own laws to combat climate change
* Banned over 250 words from federal websites and materials, including clean energy, climate crisis, climate science, pollution, science-based, social justice, and vulnerable populations;
* Attempted to cut $14 billion in clean energy grants and defunded federal climate science and weather tracking;
* Declared a “national energy emergency” to boost fossil fuel production and demanded a return to coal, the most carbon-intensive fuel;
* Began dismantling the EPA, including terminating more than 200 federal workers focused on environmental justice.

He’s also planning to cancel research grants meant to protect children from toxic chemicals like PFAs, and is reportedly going to try rescinding the tax-exempt status of non-profit environmental organizations.
**Clean air and water, and a livable planet protected from the worst impacts of climate change should not be a partisan issue.** But Trump’s administration and the modern Republican Party are more concerned about prioritizing the profits of Big Oil, Gas, and Coal — some of their largest campaign donors — over the well-being of people and our planet.
As our Attorney General, Rob has always supported climate action and environmental protections. He’s taken on the fossil fuel industry in court and supported bold action to reduce vehicle emissions and other greenhouse gases — and he’s keeping up the fight to protect California from Trump’s environmental roll-backs.
_But he can't do this alone._ **We need grassroots support to keep Rob in office working to ensure California remains at the forefront of environmental protection and action on climate.**
**[This Earth Day, will you stand with Rob by chipping in $5 or more?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-20250422?refcode=em20250422-1749&amount=5&refcode2=1749_1088799_XlI0S-&akid=1749%2E1088799%2EXlI0S-)**

Thank you,

Peter, if you just listen to nature, you’ll learn a lot. Right now, it’s screaming for us to do _something._ Instead, we get this: | “The president is celebrating Earth Day... too. In an impressive example of multi-tasking, he is curtailing federal climate science, defunding programs to help America track its weather, rescinding federal clean energy grants, and banning over 250 unacceptable words from federal literature and websites. They include clean energy, climate crisis, climate science, pollution, science-based, social justice and vulnerable populations.”

\- William Becker, Presidential Climate Action Project
---
As the only meteorologist in Congress, I feel a responsibility to call out climate misinformation when I see it.
Too often, we’re still framing the climate change “debate” around things like the dwindling polar bear population or dire warnings of a global catastrophe in 2050. While both are very real outcomes, we’re making these cuts while the climate crisis is impacting our day-to-day lives right now.
For instance, with our local farmers, even tiny temperature swings can have a major, devastating impact on crop yields. Cutting our ability to track weather, or research how to handle these oncoming challenges, is directly hurting our local economies.
Now more than ever we must fight back against this anti-science movement. We have to reaffirm our commitment to science, to truth, and to safety. And it starts with a Congress that acknowledges the increase in extreme weather around us.
**The ‘here and now’ can't be denied, and we need to secure a majority of leaders serious about this issue if we’re going to undercut climate deniers.**

We have a sitting president who genuinely believes he's above the law. Peter,

We’re watching a constitutional crisis unfold in real-time — _and it’s hitting home, right here in St. Louis._

Under Donald Trump’s second term, our immigration system has become a weapon of cruelty and chaos.

International students _right here in St. Louis_ are being targeted, their visas revoked without warning, upending their lives and dreams. These are students who came here to learn, to contribute, and to build a better future. And now? **They’re caught in a political crossfire nobody asked for.**

And then there’s the case of Kilmar Abrego Garcia — _a**legal** Maryland resident, husband, and father of three children_ — who the Trump administration illegally deported to El Salvador, where he's being detained in a prison notorious for cruelty and even murder.

The Supreme Court _unanimously_ ordered his return, but the Trump administration has refused to comply. This blatant disregard for the rule of law is not just an affront to justice and due process **but to democracy itself.**

This is a deliberate strategy to sow fear, to dehumanize, and to dismantle diverse communities.

This isn’t about immigration policy. It’s about power. It’s about a president who believes he’s above the law, who uses fear and cruelty as tools of governance. And it’s about the lives of real people — _students, neighbors, friends_ — being torn apart. People know and enjoy _The Babylon Bee_ because they produce funny, satirical content on any topic--from world news to housekeeping.

Their tagline says it all: "Fake news you can trust."

Unfortunately, the governor of California isn't laughing. And after one tweet from him, the California government passed two bills that infringe on the First Amendment right of free speech.

_The Babylon Bee_ and other plaintiffs filed a lawsuit against California officials because the bills censor free speech and punish people for posting certain political content online, including political memes and parodies of politicians.

Your voice today will tell government officials you believe the Constitution protects humor whether or not they find it funny.

name: Tim Kaine
subject: April update: Countering the chaos of Trump and Musk
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kaine for Virginia
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025]
Derek, I want to share an update with you on our five-part Democratic strategy to fight back against the chaos and unconstitutional actions of the Trump Administration and un-elected billionaire Elon Musk — and ways you can get involved.
Read on for the latest actions in five key areas: Courts, Congress, States, Elections, and Activism.
Courts
Trump has signed more than a hundred executive actions this year, and as of April 15, at least 74 judicial rulings have ordered at least temporary halts to these initiatives, thanks to a well-coordinated court strategy that began on Inauguration Day.
* The Supreme Court ruled unanimously that Trump must return Kilmar Abrego Garcia, a Maryland man who was deported to El Salvador by mistake.
* DOGE efforts to gut agencies like USAID and cut funding on scientific research at the National Institutes of Health are on hold.
* There is also pending legal action challenging the overall freeze on foreign aid, civil servant firings, the federal funding freeze, the powers of DOGE, immigration policies, and more.
We won’t win all of these fights, and it’s hard to tell how the Supreme Court would rule on these if given the chance, but what’s clear is that legal pushback from partners and allies continues to make an impact.
Congress
I’m committed to using every legislative tool at my disposal to counter Trump’s chaotic and destructive actions:
Earlier this month we had a big win when the Senate passed my legislation to un-do Trump’s wildly unpopular tariffs on Canadian imports. And last week, my colleagues and I introduced new bipartisan legislation to challenge the legality of Trump’s sweeping global tariffs that have already sent the economy into a tailspin — no president has the authority to unilaterally wage a trade war.
As summer approaches, Congress will be focused on passing the budget, and I will be fighting hard against the disastrous GOP budget plan that’s straight out of Project 2025. Not only does it promise to slash critical programs to pay for tax breaks for billionaires, it would raise the deficit by unprecedented levels. More to come on how you can help push back.
States
Dozens of state attorneys general have spoken out about Trump’s attacks on law firms and judges, and they’ve taken legal action to protect their states from dangerous orders like health funding cuts and student visa cancellations. Democratic governors and state officials are also working to put protections in place and sound the alarm about the negative impacts of this Administration on people’s everyday lives. Local elected officials will continue to play a key role in blocking the implementation of Trump’s illegal orders.
Elections
Democrats have seen victories in special elections all across the country — in Iowa, New York, Minnesota, Virginia, Oklahoma, Wisconsin, and Pennsylvania! The major Democratic win in the Wisconsin State Supreme Court election earlier this month was a particularly strong sign for our party, especially given the millions of dollars thrown at the race by Elon Musk.
This November, Virginia has a major election of our own, and I hope you’ll take action and get involved. This will be the first statewide opportunity for Democrats to make a strong statement of our electoral intentions, so we need to win — and win big. If you’re able, chip in now to my Common Ground PAC, which will be laser-focused on supporting our great VA Democrats on the ballot this November. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025] [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025]
Activism
A key part of our strategy is to turn up the pressure on this Administration through sustained, peaceful public activism. That’s where you come in.
To push for change, we need visible, vocal, and consistent pushback — and we’ve seen how effective it can be. When people show up, speak out, and organize, Republicans in swing districts start to feel the heat. Some are already backing away from the most extreme parts of their party’s agenda. That’s no coincidence.
Here’s how you can help keep the pressure on:
→ Join or support groups on the front lines like Indivisible [https://indivisible.org/take-action-now] , ACLU [https://www.aclu.org/] , NAACP [https://naacp.org/take-action] , Planned Parenthood [https://www.plannedparenthoodaction.org/] , and Human Rights Campaign [https://www.hrc.org/get-involved] .
→ Pick up the phone and call your representatives at (202) 224-3121 and tell them where you stand. Right now, it’s important to let them know you oppose budget cuts to programs like Medicaid and Social Security.
→ A really important part of this work is making sure the GOP hears loud and clear what the public thinks about their support of Trump’s actions, so calling Congress is even more critical for those who have Republican representatives or senators.
→ Show up at town halls, write letters to the editor, talk to your neighbors — and don’t underestimate the power of going digital. Share trusted info online. Join virtual events. Post your story. The more people see others speaking out, the more likely they are to join in.
I know sometimes posting online or even calling the Capitol switchboard can feel like you’re shouting into the void — but it does more than you may know. When people who care about the future of our country commit to speaking out in great numbers, the power of our activism will send a clear message to the Trump Administration and members of Congress who enable it: We see what you’re doing, and we won’t let it stand.
I know how difficult this moment is, and I appreciate hearing from each and every one of you. I promise that fighting for our democracy and our values is worth it, and I’ll be right by your side every single day.
Thanks for being here. More soon,
Tim Kaine

If you are a political junkie, then today's show is a must-watch. Jon Allen and Amie Parnes are veteran journalists that spill the tea on everything leading up to the 2024 election. As Joe Biden's cognitive collapse made its way to households around the country and the world, Biden's blunders were far more apparent and evident behind the scenes. Examples such as Biden giving then Speaker McCarthy a tour of the pool house dressing room, or asking where a deceased Congresswoman was during the tour. Biden's closest aides did everything in their power to not only keep their jobs but cover up these outrageous lapses in Biden's cognition. Meanwhile VP Harris and her team conjured up a contingency plan around Biden passing away while in office. It was shaky ground to say the least and it all came crashing down in July, when Biden met Donald Trump on the debate stage. A bitter and betrayed Biden tried to paint himself as a magnanimous leader stepping down as the top Democratic knives came out, including betrayal from Pelosi, Obama and Schumer. The problem was, nobody had faith in Kamala, including Obama, yet here she was. How could Democrats, after everything they preach, pass on the first black woman running for the highest office in the land? As tensions grew amongst Democratic camps, Donald Trump was running a very disciplined, unchaotic campaign led by Wiles and LaCivita. Kamala's scripted and sometimes edited appearances couldn't hold a candle to the long-form podcast and interviews President Trump and Vice President JD Vance were appearing in. As top Obama and Biden aides projections show Donald Trump winning, they told Harris/Walz a different story. It was only on election night as the votes came in did Kamala's bubble burst and her dreams shattered. At the end of the day, President Trump first beat Joe Biden, then beat Kamala Harris to become our 47th president.

body:

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/106317554/541126817/-926250309?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyOTc4N2MyNC1jNTFmLWYwMTEtOGIzZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2dquBb-g21t9an20UZwD-AEOVJN0tveAQ81oWM3TOiY=&emci=50ec181e-c51f-f011-8b3d-0022482a9fb7&emdi=29787c24-c51f-f011-8b3d-0022482a9fb7&ceid=24635485)
Three months of no fundraising adds up. While we were unable to fundraise during the legislative session, the rest of the world kept on moving. Friend, Today is Earth Day, and we’re pushing back against Trump’s attacks on our air, water, and climate. **The Trump administration is giving the fossil fuel and chemical industries a free pass to pollute.** They’re exempting many coal plants from Biden-era protections against arsenic and mercury in air pollution. They’re changing how the EPA evaluates the risk that chemicals pose to public health, which **could** **reverse hundreds of state and local bans on toxic chemicals**. Many states and municipalities have taken steps to ban the cancer-causing “forever chemicals” known as PFAS. PFAS is in many consumer products, and some states have banned it from items such as cookware, food packaging, clothing, firefighting gear, playground equipment, menstrual products, and cosmetics. Maine is also banning PFAS for non-essential uses.1 These state-level bans are powerful; they pushed the giant chemical corporation 3M to stop producing PFAS, and other smaller companies have agreed to find alternatives. Eleven states also set limits on PFAS in drinking water, and I helped move the EPA under former President Biden to implement life-saving nationwide standards that limit PFAS in drinking water. But this progress is at risk under Trump. [**Sign now to tell Congress: Step up to protect Americans from toxic chemicals like PFAS. Pass policies to clean up contamination, protect states’ ability to ban these cancer-causing chemicals, stop PFAS from polluting our drinking water, and phase out PFAS where alternatives are available.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38h9nrsCCiMen3CGd5zila9jzJnep0tjRIZRggydvVqTNxsH5hTNHNfYdc_iq5xrW6cyFz6qyxuOAR3sqd8pvQgb-FCoXoJxH2bzLpZ648iEheylmun3vo_AOpeLlwuewSu_GOTQU3NEDbttINe-DIN1JypvnAVT4V7WQoHQNX4pFsDxi0x7o4xCa26TkVdDlKcLw2eatxMniajo4cZNVQjLCjDMFWejWxZvPM_7Dk2Kzv1b7jKSW0jev8UTvEalzSxF98UGUzsDoCUKVy-6c1ZDCZffjH8GBYcGErGmA0RCreFaLoGQehkCkDwmkJEL000nCgek7PeaZFGo0nBG7qGsSsQt6vT5I_sGEjDKqInPxAgEGaMvdyI0ecuOTYrIbD_hJW2871qC2fEE-P0uOs0zZa8yL0LyK7tt24pbvqJ6UYNk1zFZPXDJ2QiUeasvSxntCMpdjc7VkhZ6MA-GIL_CYcua6SUbylFqlbAHcIuo_4fGWpZzqn9drW8WJuk2SWgi6QoLOyrjTxg9k_QES-5/4fv/VszP_QsSSTOPX0vqvb0-ew/h1/h001.t4UQshuJ4rkroZ7nQ0yrFKnJIEGO6UMyR8RYEo63g_s) | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38h9nrsCCiMen3CGd5zila9jzJnep0tjRIZRggydvVqTNxsH5hTNHNfYdc_iq5xrW6cyFz6qyxuOAR3sqd8pvQgb-FCoXoJxH2bzLpZ648iEheylmun3vo_AOpeLlwuewQWSGoVyDlIsW6mc04AVDATCkzHbGmzPcEE_0vZ__jNh3glrxZAhCea6HFevGF9_ZUjrPG_oPnBB-QjR67XX9STX3NCRDWpoHUMEZMU7nb4eo7dcz9WlzyFAIqWymqHKZl4el2QczdJXctXFsjI_8kcsn1eo_dCH-bR5iff_gZHqCN7SIPh9FLZa-e6koMlvaUmcis_3W7cguIyiww3agjY90RsIFGtZfV_Retal1ROsq326jNHF1vSW4ucQMtRK18TbnGh4xzEk6MPTR2cHl7V97RietZbL3V09p9puvICs7cg5S2ibn2ns6mufVgIxEp-IpdAnXiU2a6XQyDCwmlwyduhvV17YZWEzp5MWi5zlm8-Oauf0JxzKLaLnbkRXlht-Tp0qT-tO43leZo3Fq17/4fv/VszP_QsSSTOPX0vqvb0-ew/h2/h001.jh-vP-S-8EuZ6-wYRJRJz0sqQW5X0fWqYegBc0FT-9c)

PFAS chemicals cause cancer, damage children’s development, and harm immune and reproductive systems. They don’t degrade, so they persist and build up over time in the environment and in our bodies.
We have the right to breathe clean air and clean water, and I’ve worked alongside environmental justice activists for years to protect that right. My state of Michigan has more known sites contaminated with PFAS than any other state.
I passed an amendment putting frontline communities first when remediating PFAS, and I helped push the EPA to:
* Dedicate $1 billion to help states test and treat PFAS contamination.
* Designate two types of PFAS as hazardous substances, requiring reporting of contamination and ensuring that corporate polluters pay for cleaning up contaminated sites.
* Enact historic nationwide standards to limit PFAS in drinking water.

I also moved the EPA to adopt a historic policy to replace all lead service lines that carry water to people’s homes in U.S. communities. This is part of the progress I’ve pushed for in the fight to protect families from lead poisoning.
But all of these EPA initiatives are under threat with the new president. Trump is illegally firing the EPA staff who do environmental justice and contamination cleanup work. (He can’t do this without Congressional approval.) He’s also taking steps to weaken or roll back Biden-era protections, including withdrawing a Biden-era plan to limit industrial PFAS pollution in waterways.
Too often, federal agencies’ policies are subject to presidential whims. We need to make these public health protections permanent by passing them through Congress.
[**Sign on to demand Congress act now to protect Americans from cancer-causing toxic chemicals.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38h9nrsCCiMen3CGd5zila9jzJnep0tjRIZRggydvVqTNxsH5hTNHNfYdc_iq5xrW6cyFz6qyxuOAR3sqd8pvQgb-FCoXoJxH2bzLpZ648iEheylmun3vo_AOpeLlwuewRWMo6NS5yL42ajQYzYncuDyuw2cxYAtnlVOe4ogp4Jb8BbGkNAwMDWlGbq3A0pupzUOK7uKzis1hXp8In4kflJ3P1ywCkEIhnBwTVxintb1Ke6oZUQogIq83jWNSm9UZCOGmQhsxqmqfHjQCV0QAb-kjaEU1kDlM22oEQ6VRrfIjeLMQnrCN6HVaRelS9oyWw0YAWhVqohtopQ14yMmefy65gS0llqCL0b8pD4oBeMV9YEJ8IcVSTqzNSiONOu7414__dwnxY-Fl2qwfQ4oOe-CXJAkfWipgz5xm0J2BfUXXsrG9PKJpMQMHzfZ3XduSYXSVZXCBK3X31iodxoGw-zJtgbzPSy_3tvvzzquacl_AgjVIXRiKG7eO6kXSj-6s73FsCkMRI_cIKsdx8ZX86M/4fv/VszP_QsSSTOPX0vqvb0-ew/h3/h001.NfXs70pa0zO8xiK2omyvGxK1reL8MSMsEgheI8p6CJ4)
Thank you for continuing to demand better. Together, we will keep pushing for environmental justice for all.
With you in this fight,
Rashida

With Earth Day tomorrow, we’re shining a light on how Trump is poisoning our air and water—and how we can fight back.
Trump has appointed EPA staff who have lobbied for chemical corporations and opposed bans on asbestos. He’s also illegally firing workers who clean up toxic contamination and focus on environmental justice. His administration also terminated an agreement to protect majority-Black communities from raw sewage, and exempted nearly 70 coal plants from Biden-era protections against mercury and arsenic. This is unacceptable.
For decades, I’ve worked with movements to bring about environmental justice. Under the Biden administration, **I helped push for historic drinking water standards to protect families from toxic chemicals known as PFAS.** **These “forever chemicals” cause cancer** , harm immune and reproductive systems, and damage children’s development. They accumulate in our bodies and they never break down or biodegrade.
**Now Trump’s taking steps to roll back Biden-era plans and regulations to limit PFAS chemicals.**
**He’s also trying to reverse hundreds of state and local PFAS bans** , which have protected people from PFAS in consumer products like cookware, food packaging, clothing, firefighting gear, playground equipment, and cosmetics.

The DuPont corporation knew as early as 1961 that PFAS chemicals (shorthand for per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances) were toxic and caused serious health effects. In order to continue profiting, DuPont buried that information and made tens of billions of dollars for decades while the rest of us were being poisoned.
My state of Michigan has more known sites contaminated with PFAS than any other state.
I’ve worked alongside my constituents to clean up these “forever chemicals,” including pushing for cleanup funding, holding community town halls with environmental leaders, and using my position in the House Oversight Committee to push the FDA to safeguard our food and hold chemical companies like DuPont accountable for the harms of PFAS.
I also passed an amendment to prioritize cleaning up PFAS in frontline communities that have been disproportionately impacted by pollution, climate change, and environmental destruction.
As part of protecting the human right to water, I’ve also passed amendments that would provide $23 billion to fully replace dangerous lead pipes. And I successfully pushed the EPA to adopt a historic requirement to replace all poisonous lead service lines that carry water to people’s homes... but if the EPA staff who’d implement this policy are all fired, it won’t happen.
That’s why Congress needs to push federal agencies on these issues. When Congress passes a law, it’s much harder to overturn than policies enacted by presidents within federal agencies.
[**Sign now to urge Congress: Protect Americans from toxic chemicals like cancer-causing PFAS. Thank you for taking action. We can’t let the water we rely on be sacrificed for corporate greed. That includes protecting water from oil and gas pipelines.
Unfortunately, Trump is also**** fast-tracking permits for the destructive Line 5 pipeline under the Great Lakes, which would threaten drinking water for more than 40 million people. I’ve met with Tribal leaders who’ve kept up the fight to shut down Line 5, reminding us that “water is life.”
I will continue standing up to corporations that exploit our water and violate our Indigenous neighbors’ rights. Together, we will demand our government respect the human right to breathe clean air and drink clean water.
With you in the fight for our environment and our rights,
Rashida

clean_body: Standing up to Trump and corporate polluters, Earth Day and every day. | | | Friend, Today is Earth Day, and we’re pushing back against Trump’s attacks on our air, water, and climate. The Trump administration is giving the fossil fuel and chemical industries a free pass to pollute. They’re exempting many coal plants from Biden-era protections against arsenic and mercury in air pollution. They’re changing how the EPA evaluates the risk that chemicals pose to public health, which could reverse hundreds of state and local bans on toxic chemicals. Many states and municipalities have taken steps to ban the cancer-causing “forever chemicals” known as PFAS. PFAS is in many consumer products, and some states have banned it from items such as cookware, food packaging, clothing, firefighting gear, playground equipment, menstrual products, and cosmetics. Maine is also banning PFAS for non-essential uses.1 These state-level bans are powerful; they pushed the giant chemical corporation 3M to stop producing PFAS, and other smaller companies have agreed to find alternatives. Eleven states also set limits on PFAS in drinking water, and I helped move the EPA under former President Biden to implement life-saving nationwide standards that limit PFAS in drinking water. But this progress is at risk under Trump. | PFAS chemicals cause cancer, damage children’s development, and harm immune and reproductive systems. They don’t degrade, so they persist and build up over time in the environment and in our bodies. We have the right to breathe clean air and clean water, and I’ve worked alongside environmental justice activists for years to protect that right. My state of Michigan has more known sites contaminated with PFAS than any other state. I passed an amendment putting frontline communities first when remediating PFAS, and I helped push the EPA to: Dedicate $1 billion to help states test and treat PFAS contamination. Designate two types of PFAS as hazardous substances, requiring reporting of contamination and ensuring that corporate polluters pay for cleaning up contaminated sites. Enact historic nationwide standards to limit PFAS in drinking water. I also moved the EPA to adopt a historic policy to replace all lead service lines that carry water to people’s homes in U.S. communities. This is part of the progress I’ve pushed for in the fight to protect families from lead poisoning. But all of these EPA initiatives are under threat with the new president. Trump is illegally firing the EPA staff who do environmental justice and contamination cleanup work. (He can’t do this without Congressional approval.) He’s also taking steps to weaken or roll back Biden-era protections, including withdrawing a Biden-era plan to limit industrial PFAS pollution in waterways. Too often, federal agencies’ policies are subject to presidential whims. We need to make these public health protections permanent by passing them through Congress. Thank you for continuing to demand better. Together, we will keep pushing for environmental justice for all. With you in this fight, Rashida 1 \---------- Forwarded message --------- From: Rashida Tlaib**** Date: Mon, Apr 21, 2025 Subject: Trump and his chemical industry buddies want to profit off poisoning our air and water. To: dpwillis67@gmail.com Friend, With Earth Day tomorrow, we’re shining a light on how Trump is poisoning our air and water—and how we can fight back. Trump has appointed EPA staff who have lobbied for chemical corporations and opposed bans on asbestos. He’s also illegally firing workers who clean up toxic contamination and focus on environmental justice. His administration also terminated an agreement to protect majority-Black communities from raw sewage, and exempted nearly 70 coal plants from Biden-era protections against mercury and arsenic. This is unacceptable. For decades, I’ve worked with movements to bring about environmental justice. Under the Biden administration, I helped push for historic drinking water standards to protect families from toxic chemicals known as PFAS. These “forever chemicals” cause cancer , harm immune and reproductive systems, and damage children’s development. They accumulate in our bodies and they never break down or biodegrade. Now Trump’s taking steps to roll back Biden-era plans and regulations to limit PFAS chemicals. He’s also trying to reverse hundreds of state and local PFAS bans , which have protected people from PFAS in consumer products like cookware, food packaging, clothing, firefighting gear, playground equipment, and cosmetics. The DuPont corporation knew as early as 1961 that PFAS chemicals (shorthand for per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances) were toxic and caused serious health effects. In order to continue profiting, DuPont buried that information and made tens of billions of dollars for decades while the rest of us were being poisoned. My state of Michigan has more known sites contaminated with PFAS than any other state. I’ve worked alongside my constituents to clean up these “forever chemicals,” including pushing for cleanup funding, holding community town halls with environmental leaders, and using my position in the House Oversight Committee to push the FDA to safeguard our food and hold chemical companies like DuPont accountable for the harms of PFAS. I also passed an amendment to prioritize cleaning up PFAS in frontline communities that have been disproportionately impacted by pollution, climate change, and environmental destruction. As part of protecting the human right to water, I’ve also passed amendments that would provide $23 billion to fully replace dangerous lead pipes. And I successfully pushed the EPA to adopt a historic requirement to replace all poisonous lead service lines that carry water to people’s homes... but if the EPA staff who’d implement this policy are all fired, it won’t happen. That’s why Congress needs to push federal agencies on these issues. When Congress passes a law, it’s much harder to overturn than policies enacted by presidents within federal agencies. Thank you for taking action. We can’t let the water we rely on be sacrificed for corporate greed. That includes protecting water from oil and gas pipelines. Unfortunately, Trump is also fast-tracking permits for the destructive Line 5 pipeline under the Great Lakes, which would threaten drinking water for more than 40 million people. I’ve met with Tribal leaders who’ve kept up the fight to shut down Line 5, reminding us that “water is life.” I will continue standing up to corporations that exploit our water and violate our Indigenous neighbors’ rights. Together, we will demand our government respect the human right to breathe clean air and drink clean water. With you in the fight for our environment and our rights, Rashida * Rashida Tlaib for Congress PO Box 32777 Detroit, MI 48232 | Paid for by Rashida Tlaib for Congress | | Sent via . name: Mark Kelly
subject: We knew Hegseth was unqualified. Now, he’s proven it.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
We warned about this back in his confirmation hearing, and we’re in this position today because my Republican colleagues did not listen. But the best time to fix that mistake is today.
#

Folks, if I had a nickel for every time we heard about Pete Hegseth breaking operational security by using Signal, I’d have two nickels now.
This is serious.
Hegeth is not taking the job seriously. He can’t be trusted. Frankly, he was never up to the job in the first place. We warned about this back in his confirmation hearing, and we’re in this position today because my Republican colleagues did not listen. But the best time to fix that mistake is today.
There’s got to be an investigation into Hegseth’s conduct, there needs to be accountability for this, and there absolutely has to be an actionable plan from the Trump Administration to prevent anything like this from happening again.
But before that happens, Pete Hegseth needs to resign or be fired.
He was unqualified and unprepared on day one. He’s proven it now. Our troops can’t afford another day with this guy putting their lives in jeopardy.

name: Marie Gluesenkamp Perez
subject: Celebrating Earth Day in Southwest Washington
body:
| | Peter,

Coming from a family of loggers, I learned early on that being a good steward of the Earth isn’t just a slogan – **it’s a way of life.**

Here in Southwest Washington, our forests, rivers, and lands aren’t just beautiful – they’re the backbone of our _economy, communities, and future._ From logging to recreation to small farms, protecting these natural resources is **part of who we are.**

**That’s why, this Earth Day, I’m proud to reaffirm my commitment to responsible stewardship and common-sense conservation.**

This year, I’ve been working hard to protect the places we love:
* I introduced the _Community Wood Facilities Assistance Act_ to strengthen markets for sustainably harvested wood and create good-paying jobs here in Southwest Washington.
* I led the charge to extend the _National Landslide Preparedness Act_ , helping our communities in landslide-prone areas stay safe and resilient.
* And I fought back against federal workforce cuts that would have hurt wildfire readiness, timber production, and recreation on our public lands.

Earth Day is a time to come together and honor the land that sustains us here in Southwest Washington. Whether it’s our forests, rivers, or coastlines, being good stewards means showing up and protecting these places – for our kids, for our economy, and for future generations.

**We still have work to do. Climate change, forest health, clean water access – these are real challenges facing our region. But together, we can meet them with the same grit, determination, and care that defines Southwest Washington.**

Thank you for standing with me in this work, today and every day.

Happy Earth Day,
Marie

clean_body: | | Peter, Coming from a family of loggers, I learned early on that being a good steward of the Earth isn’t just a slogan – it’s a way of life. Here in Southwest Washington, our forests, rivers, and lands aren’t just beautiful – they’re the backbone of our economy, communities, and future. From logging to recreation to small farms, protecting these natural resources is part of who we are. That’s why, this Earth Day, I’m proud to reaffirm my commitment to responsible stewardship and common-sense conservation. This year, I’ve been working hard to protect the places we love: I introduced the Community Wood Facilities Assistance Act to strengthen markets for sustainably harvested wood and create good-paying jobs here in Southwest Washington. I led the charge to extend the National Landslide Preparedness Act , helping our communities in landslide-prone areas stay safe and resilient. And I fought back against federal workforce cuts that would have hurt wildfire readiness, timber production, and recreation on our public lands. Earth Day is a time to come together and honor the land that sustains us here in Southwest Washington. Whether it’s our forests, rivers, or coastlines, being good stewards means showing up and protecting these places – for our kids, for our economy, and for future generations. We still have work to do. Climate change, forest health, clean water access – these are real challenges facing our region. He did not scrub mission critical information that could endanger the lives of the men and women in harm’s way if it leaked. He used his personal cellphone to do it. And he did it just days after a member of his own staff warned him that Signal chats could be compromised by our adversaries.
#
Peter:
We figured this was the case, but it’s stunning to see it confirmed.
Today, we learned that the Commander of CENT-COM communicated forthcoming strike details to the Secretary of Defense using secured systems, as required when communicating classified information like this. He did his job, and followed proper protocol.
SECDEF Pete Hegseth then copied, pasted, and sent that information to two Signal groups. One was the chat with _The Atlantic_ reporter Jeffrey Goldberg and other national security officials, which we’ve known about for a month. The other was a personal chat which included his wife, his brother, and his personal lawyer, which we just learned about this week.
**Hegseth leaked classified information — timelines, aircraft, weapon systems — to even more people who never should’ve had access to it.**
He sent it just ten minutes after he received it from the CENT-COM Commander. He did not scrub mission critical details that could endanger the lives of the men and women in harm’s way. He used his personal cellphone to do it. And he did it just days after a member of his own staff warned him that Signal chats could be compromised by our adversaries.

Pete Hegseth is the most unqualified, incompetent, immature Secretary of Defense in the history of the United States. **A literal pile of rocks would be a better option than this guy.** VoteVets is going to do everything in our power to get him fired or force him out of the job. Today, we honor the incredible planet we all call home — and recommit ourselves to protecting it for generations to come. Climate change is a real and urgent threat with long-term repercussions. It requires immediate and decisive action to safeguard our future. But with Donald Trump in the White House, the fight for our planet has never been more important. | It is our shared responsibility to preserve the planet for future generations by promoting conservation efforts, mitigating the impacts of climate change on communities across the nation, and investing in renewable energy. The climate crisis provides an opportunity to transform our economy by investing in renewable energy sources to transition away from fossil fuels, and creating sustainable green jobs. That’s all the more reason that we must do everything we can to protect our planet for future generations. But the climate crisis is here, and our current efforts simply aren’t enough. Thanks for standing with me. | | Team, In Georgia and across the country, far-right election deniers are using an insidious tool to try to reshape the electorate: _mass voter purges_. Here’s how this voter suppression tactic can work: A single right-wing activist — with guidance from a systematic anti-voter network — can submit official challenges to specific people’s voter registrations. In Georgia, Republican voter suppression legislation — passed after Trump’s 2020 loss — has allowed one person to try to purge an _unlimited_ number of their fellow Georgians from the rolls. In those attempts, private citizens can use flawed, incomplete data — as shown by an analysis we commissioned last year — to claim that certain voters are no longer eligible. After a purge attempt, people need to jump through additional hoops to maintain their registrations. If elections officials sign off on the purge, those Americans could no longer be able to vote. And even if that doesn’t happen, the effort still forces officials to waste valuable time and serves as voter intimidation. Tuesday, April 22, 2025 | Peter -- Last week, we asked about how economic policy affects your personal lives, with the cost of groceries and everyday items being the biggest financial stressor for Forwardists. This week, we continued our _**Controlling What You Can**_ __ series by diving deeper on the economy. We looked at the larger picture of national economics, asking you about the choices you think we should be making as a country when it comes to our economic decision making. Here's what you had to say: Forwardists have some interesting thoughts about our economic position. This poll—more than any other we've had so far—has had the most split sentiment reading, with 34% of you thinking that current economic choices are making us _more_ competitive. Still, 66% of you disagree with that assessment. The national debt looms large on Forwardists minds, with our current Debt to GDP ratio at an alarming 130%. Wage stagnation was a fairly close second, though. As an example of why that might be top of mind: in 1985, the median home price was about 4 times the median income; today, it's [nearly 8 times.](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=bdryXrxauB4JooobNLeHLTwgIQTvOLd6ihCzK9C3bRoZo888etDhQfQSFnz_FxXmwUKccdpDlo4wfXDHSZw-vOBo6DSGxtN-0MBxqZXeuWY&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_60&n=2) Thank you for your suggestions and ideas on how the government can approach these issues. Here is a summary of what you said: **Reforming Institutions & Preparing For The Next Disruptor**
* You called for the government to modernize our economic strategies, looking forward to what's coming next instead of just looking at pain points for today.
* Many of you cited the rise of Artificial Intelligence and the possible downturn it could cause in the job market as an area for which to prepare.

**Wage Stagnation & Retirement Security**
* Stagnation of wages across the last few decades has made the American dream just a dream for an ever growing number of people.
* The safety net of Social Security isn't keeping up with the rapid increase in cost of living—you called for a more responsive benefits system.

**Innovation & Technology Leadership**
* There was a strongly expressed desire for the US to continue to be the center of global innovation and the leader in new technologies. The less we invest in R&D, the sooner other countries will outpace us.

[Andrew Yang Joins Andrew Cuomo On News Nation To Discuss Tariffs](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=_KeSraPW0gSlxEBMOvJrEouH4SjeZmYtvTWulgNFAfbafEmF2BuCbedKjxNFDPif&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_60&n=3) | _NewsNation_ Andrew discusses how tariffs should work if someone wanted to do them with the intent of repatriating manufacturing. It would require stable tariffs and a broad horizon, not the fickle policies of today. [New Political Party Seeking Expanded Democracy And A Return To The Center Launches In New Mexico](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=j2MVlYG_6z0LG_AwXb0aHggb75Sw-DzsxLREPnyv6ONnHTF9PMe7WFEct_MlNp1KpjLDDu3Od5hdq01Tchj03fMTymxI2ngCy8zHtqvwepapQPZHE4EOFRkkTgfrkk8-XVU_7HBDV8P3q2cfsjRfOhBPuX9-e82vTl7wlrJyzo8vzqewT8DfFcSMuQR0_wWY&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_60&n=4) | _Source NM_ The Forward Party in New Mexico launches its bid for 3500 signatures to secure minor party status. “If you look at what is the root cause of hyper-partisanship and political polarization in this country, you can trace a lot of it to how we elect, district and finance candidates,” says Bob Perls, chair of the New Mexico Forward Party
**April 23 | Virginia Forward x Andrew Yang
** The Virginia Forward Party hosts Andrew Yang to discuss the founding of Forward and the progress made in Massachusetts. The interview will be conducted by Sophia Nelson, a former Forward candidate in the state. [**Register →**](https://home.forwardparty.com/vafwd_x_andrew_yang_042025?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_60&n=5) **April 23 | Veterans Roundtable
** Join the Veterans and Veterans Family Committee for a virtual roundtable discussing the current administrations policies and the DOGE cuts effects on veteran employment and workforce stability. body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

After Donald Trump sent the stock market into decline with his tariffs a
few weeks ago, he openly encouraged people to buy stocks while the prices
were low, right before he lifted many of the tariffs.

As a result, many in Trump’s inner circle, including Rep. Marjorie Taylor
Greene, bought dozens of stocks at the right time just to see their values
soar. It’s called insider trading, and it should be stopped, but
Democratic leaders are guilty of it, too.

Countless polls show that banning stock trading or ownership by government
officials has widespread public approval, even across party lines. Over
the past two Congressional sessions, Sludge found that many in office
support a ban: more than 100 members of Congress on both sides of the
aisle have co-sponsored bills to ban congressional and executive stock
trading.

But party leaders who decide what bills get brought to a vote have stood
in the way, including Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer and House
Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250422?refcode=em20250422-36605&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36605_1203867_gYsmM0&akid=36605%2E1203867%2EgYsmM0 ]Sludge: Congressional Leaders Warning of ‘Insider Trading’ Could Have
Banned Officials From Stock Trading. Banning members of Congress and
government officials from trading stocks is highly popular, even among
many rank and file lawmakers—but not among the congressional leaders who
control which bills advance.

As Sludge reports, “No bill limiting lawmakers’ stock trading has been
granted a committee vote in the House, and no bill on the topic has been
voted on by the full Senate. Congressional leaders like Chuck Schumer who
are now voicing concerns over “insider trading” are the ones who have been
sitting on bills that could have constrained insiders from making moves
for profit.”

This is exactly why we need to clean house in the Democratic Party and
elect more progressive, working-class champions who will prioritize people
over profits by supporting an end to congressional stock trading.

elections. Will you directly fuel our work with a grassroots donation of
$5 now?

name: Sunhee Volz
subject: Happy Earth Day!
body:
https://www.aacfpennsylvania.org [https://www.aacfpennsylvania.org]
Hi Peter,
Today is Earth Day - a day to honor and celebrate the achievements that have been made in the environmental movement and the steps that we've taken as a community to protect our planet.
Our Asian American communities in Pennsylvania are directly suffering the effects of dirty air, lead in our water, and other forms of environmental harm. Through talking to our communities we've learned that 84% of Asian Pacific Islander Pennsylvanians support a just transition away from fossil fuels that creates good jobs for our communities in the process.
We know that everyone from South Philadelphia to Pittsburgh and everywhere in between deserves a safe and clean environment that can sustain life for current and future generations. By joining together as a community, we can rewrite the rules so that every family has what we need to get and stay well, every working person has a safe, good job, and every community can protect our world for generations to come.
That's why we want to learn more about your vision and priorities for how we get to the future that we are building together. Will you take our environmental justice survey so that we can learn what you most need in your neighborhood and how we can better serve you? [https://www.surveyhero.com/c/EJ2025]

Friend, I might have one of the toughest assignments in Washington.

\- I’m a freshman in one of the most competitive seats in the country.
\- I’m a Democrat in the minority, trying to make progress in a broken Congress.
\- I flipped this seat last year by just 653 votes.

For a lot of folks in my position, that kind of pressure means hunkering down and playing it safe. Some turn to special interests like Big Pharma and Oil just to survive the next election.

**That’s not how I plan to do things.**

I’m staying focused on the people who sent me here. Every weekend, I come home to listen -- at local businesses, events, and in conversation with constituents, whether they voted for me or not.

That’s what a healthy democracy should look like, team. And if we’re going to fix what’s broken in Washington, it starts in tight races like CA-45. And it starts with keeping the voices of the people front and center.

**[If you’re ready to 1.) support a campaign grounded in community, 2.) protect a critical House seat, and 3.) show Washington what real representation looks like, I hope you’ll chip in $3 today.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/106321004/541138653/2039042026?refcode=em-4.22.25-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3ODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYjdkYTEzNzgtZDExZi1mMDExLThiM2QtMDAyMjQ4MmE5ZmI3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=faqUhtzIK9Jb4NRK4N3DHozMyj2e1dxHWYT5h2vAZNM=)**

Thanks for sticking with me. It means the world.

Derek

Let’s win in Michigan and help Democrats take back the Senate.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/106321273/541139471/2067698065?amount=10&refcode=em_fr_2025.04.22_b1_hs_all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY3MjEiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYjYyOTNmZDUtZDExZi1mMDExLThiM2QtMDAyMjQ4MmE5ZmI3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=S14k4iDBRI_xZkSOUQE2uOsrEd5VswDxZn2toOzId7Q=)

Hi, team – this is Congresswoman Haley Stevens writing to you with exciting news: Today, I’m launching my campaign for Michigan’s open U.S. Senate seat.

Winning in Michigan is essential to regaining our Democratic Senate majority, and right now The Cook Political Report is rating our race as a “Toss Up.” That means we’re already one of the GOP’s top targets for defeat. Just last year, they spent nearly $80 million trying to buy Michigan’s Senate seat and came up only 0.3% short, so I need your early support to win.

**Friend, I want to tell you a bit more about myself and why I’m running.[But if that’s all you needed to hear and you’re ready to get to work, please chip in whatever you can – split between my campaign and Janelle Bynum – to help hit our $1 million launch goal and become a Founding Donor of my campaign to keep Michigan blue.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/106321274/541139472/2067698065?amount=10&refcode=em_fr_2025.04.22_b1_hs_all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY3MjEiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYjYyOTNmZDUtZDExZi1mMDExLThiM2QtMDAyMjQ4MmE5ZmI3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=S14k4iDBRI_xZkSOUQE2uOsrEd5VswDxZn2toOzId7Q=)** | [**CHIP IN »**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/106321275/541139473/2067698065?amount=10&refcode=em_fr_2025.04.22_b1_hs_all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY3MjEiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYjYyOTNmZDUtZDExZi1mMDExLThiM2QtMDAyMjQ4MmE5ZmI3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=S14k4iDBRI_xZkSOUQE2uOsrEd5VswDxZn2toOzId7Q=)

I’m proud to be a lifelong Michigander. I learned the value of hard work by watching my parents – who owned their own landscaping business – build things. Heavy machinery equipment, bobcats, plows, dirt, grease, and grime – it was all part of my childhood.

Later in life, I got the call to give back to the state I love during a time of great uncertainty: the Great Recession. **I can’t tell you how unfathomable it was to hear the words “bankruptcy” and “General Motors” in the same sentence.** So I stepped up to do my part and served as chief of staff for the Auto Rescue initiative under President Obama.

We brought workers, corporations, and union leadership around the same table to stabilize the auto industry. On Friday nights, I’d stay in the office until the late evening and return every call from every Michigander who called our office worried about the future. _In the end, we saved 200,000 Michigan jobs._

I can’t help but see parallels between then and now as we find ourselves in another moment of great uncertainty, thanks to the chaos forced on us by Donald Trump and his billionaire buddy Elon Musk.

People are rightly concerned about rising costs, shoot-from-the-hip tariffs, and attacks on our personal freedoms. **Michiganders need a fighter in their corner – and that’s who I’ve been my entire life.**

[**If you’re ready to fight with me – to win this battleground race, take back the Senate majority, and stop Trump – can you split a grassroots donation between my campaign and Janelle Bynum? Every dollar counts toward my $1 million campaign launch goal.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/106321276/541139474/2067698065?amount=10&refcode=em_fr_2025.04.22_b1_hs_all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY3MjEiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYjYyOTNmZDUtZDExZi1mMDExLThiM2QtMDAyMjQ4MmE5ZmI3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=S14k4iDBRI_xZkSOUQE2uOsrEd5VswDxZn2toOzId7Q=)

I know a thing or two about winning competitive races when the odds are stacked against me. Back in 2018, I flipped a battleground House seat from red to blue and helped usher in a Democratic majority to serve as a check on the first Trump administration. I was also just recognized as the most effective Michigan congressperson in the House.

I’m taking that tenacity straight to the campaign trail. But I need you with me. Donald Trump’s handpicked candidate, Mike Rogers, is running again – and we know Republicans will spend tens of millions of dollars to buy this Senate seat for Trump.

**That’s why we must build the strongest possible campaign from day one:[Help me hit this $1 million campaign launch goal by making a gift of $10 (split with Janelle). With your support, we’ll win Michigan’s open Senate seat, take back the Senate for Democrats, and stop the chaos and uncertainty of the Trump administration.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/106321277/541139475/2067698065?amount=10&refcode=em_fr_2025.04.22_b1_hs_all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY3MjEiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYjYyOTNmZDUtZDExZi1mMDExLThiM2QtMDAyMjQ4MmE5ZmI3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=S14k4iDBRI_xZkSOUQE2uOsrEd5VswDxZn2toOzId7Q=)**

Thank you for being a part of this team right from the get-go. I’m so grateful for your support.

Haley

The Fighting Oligarchy tour continues.
#
Do you know that constant pressure that we're feeling in our lives lately? That, right now, is **what it feels like to be governed by billionaires**.
But we have a message for Donald Trump and his billionaire donors:
We will not be distracted.
We will not be discouraged.
We will build the prosperous, free nation for all that we deserve.
**The time to organize is now**. That's why Alexandria just traveled with Bernie to vulnerable, GOP-held districts in California, Utah, Idaho, and Montana — and **that's why they'll be annoncing even more tour stops soon**.
For a limited-time, when you make a $27 contribution to Alexandria's campaign from this email, **we’ll send you our newest poster from the Fighting Oligarchy Tour!**

Team AOC
